title: More Grayter | KEY.co
description_expanded: The second floor hosts not just one, but two master bedrooms, each boasting king-sized beds, walk-in closets, and splendid master bathrooms with deep soaking tubs and separate showers highlighted by elegant marble countertops. The communal areas are equally impressive: a spacious kitchen with marble counters and a custom four-burner Wolf range invites guests to indulge in culinary adventures, complemented by a dining area seating eight and adjacent to a balcony perfect for morning coffees or sunset cocktails. As the residence unfolds to the third floor, guests discover three more beautifully appointed bedrooms, each with its own en-suite and luxurious finishes. The pinnacle of the home is the fourth-floor bunk room and den—ideal for younger guests—with balconies offering unparalleled neighborhood and lake views, crafting an unforgettable setting for relaxation and making memories. Tucked away in a serene lakeside community, this exquisite five-bedroom, five-and-a-half-bathroom residence promises a luxurious retreat ideal for families and large groups. The heart of the home features a generous, screened-in porch on the first floor—perfect for lazy afternoons of ping pong, card games on the high-top table, or enjoying the big game sprawled out on the huge sectional sofa. Each space is thoughtfully designed, from the vast driveway accommodating four vehicles to the architectural grace of the interiors. The journey begins with a stately half bathroom conveniently situated between the two main floors, leading to a spectacular second-floor setting.
